# prices

Cost-benefit calculator for supermarket use (React + Vite + TypeScript PWA), with a planned shopping-list module.
Live demo: https://prices-mauve.vercel.app

## Docs

- [README](README.md): setup, features, stack, architecture, decisions.
- [docs/README](docs/README.md): living documentation home.

## Product

- [docs/04-management/project-brief.md](docs/04-management/project-brief.md): vision, scope, stakeholders, success criteria.
- [docs/04-management/roadmap.md](docs/04-management/roadmap.md): phases and milestones (M-01 to M-10).
- [docs/04-management/initial-backlog.md](docs/04-management/initial-backlog.md): calculator backlog CB-01 to CB-29.
- [docs/04-management/shopping-list-brief.md](docs/04-management/shopping-list-brief.md): list module vision, flows, UX.
- [docs/04-management/shopping-list-backlog.md](docs/04-management/shopping-list-backlog.md): list backlog SL-00+.

## Architecture

- [docs/02-architecture/architecture-review.md](docs/02-architecture/architecture-review.md): stack, folder structure, Zustand, AD-01 to AD-06.
- [docs/02-architecture/shopping-list-architecture.md](docs/02-architecture/shopping-list-architecture.md): routes, list slice, handoff, AD-07 to AD-10.

## Way of working

- [docs/04-management/development-standards.md](docs/04-management/development-standards.md): branches, Conventional Commits, merge checklist, Definition of Done.

## Code map

- `src/main.tsx`: bootstrap (styles, i18n, PWA registration).
- `src/App.tsx`: BrowserRouter — `/` List, `/compare` Calculator, BottomNav.
- `src/app/`: PWA registration, preferences store.
- `src/features/calculator/`: Compare page, components, hooks, stores, pure domain lib.
- `src/features/list/`: ListPage checklist, listStore, handoff seed/apply (Sprint L0–L2).
- `src/components/ui/`: BottomNav, segmented control, toggles, badges, inputs.
- `src/i18n/locales/`: en.json, pt-BR.json (no hardcoded UI strings).
- `src/lib/`: Intl currency helpers.
- `vite.config.ts`: Tailwind, PWA manifest, Vitest.
- `index.html`: meta, theme-color, pre-paint theme guard.
